journey.name: profile cleanup failure
journey.description: Requires a disposable test identity with saved contacts and a controlled homeserver proxy. Never use a personal profile. Inject a private-endpoint withdrawal failure, then in a fresh fixture inject an unknown contact-removal response or a partial removal retaining an active peer. Also inject a profile-deletion error whose message contains 404 Not Found, without confirming deletion. These controls are not available in standard staging. This journey covers stopping on incomplete cleanup, not cross-device conditional deletion or safe manual replay of an uncertain operation.

actions.action: Open Edit Profile and confirm deletion with the cleanup fault enabled
Verify failure options appear without a success notification or onboarding navigation
Verify a failed private withdrawal is followed by no contact or profile deletion
Verify unknown contact removal keeps local contact data and prevents profile deletion
Verify partial contact removal preserves contacts and overrides not acknowledged as removed
Verify an uncertain profile-deletion error preserves the session and sharing settings without success feedback
Cancel the failure dialog and verify the app starts no second deletion
Restart the app and verify no profile deletion is automatically replayed
